A coherent broad philosophy programme is not a sufficient closest response to IPS.

courseReview.finding: Replaced the historical art/heritage-heavy palette with a stronger social/political/textual challenge. Both complete research trials are mechanically feasible. Every currently plausible Islamic/religious lead was examined through actual profile/topics/methods or description2; the whole 151-course workbook was read and searched for related teaching. Genuine narrative, Islamic-court art, religious rights, philosophy and social-method connections are explicitly retained. They do not collectively provide sustained Islamic historical sources, theology/intellectual traditions, sacred-text authority and lived Muslim-community inquiry.
courseReview.progression: Philosophical/sociological foundations precede advanced interpretation, ethics and theory; legal gateway precedes Constitutional Law. Research and policy courses obey actual offerings/prerequisites; no new prerequisite or hypothetical scheduled Islamic research is introduced.

academicJudgment.conclusion: Approve robust no-defensible-UCR-match under the existing bounded-materiality standard; exact production pair read back and all applicable CI successful.
academicJudgment.strongestArgumentForQualification: A complete UCR programme can sustain social/political inquiry, ethnography, critical history, cultural narrative, constitutional religious freedom and existential ethics. IPS itself includes social/political and optional broader study. General methodological/content overlap is substantial enough to demand a real programme-level challenge.
academicJudgment.whyItFails: The strongest programme remains organized around general public authority, social theory, interpretation and ethical questions. IPS develops those approaches through sustained inquiry into Islamic traditions, religious sources/authority and Muslim lives. The current UCR narrative and Mediterranean Islamic-court contributions are specific but do not sustain that academic object. Expanding from a few connections to a broad social/political programme would replace the defining object rather than provide a sufficiently close limited response. This is a content-and-weight judgment with no disciplinary-equivalence or EC quota.
academicJudgment.notAProxy: The judgment does not rely on Arabic, Cairo, a missing degree title, a professional license, an uncertain single-course prerequisite or lack of an exact institutional format. It applies to the selected without-Arabic pathway.
